text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic complete hollow outfit, no person, skin or visible mannequin, pure white seamless background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, fully uncropped. Garments: White fitted short sleeve tee, light washed blue wide-leg jeans, dark shoes conservatively completed below cropped reference.. Add ONLY these accessories: Black narrow rectangular sunglasses with dark lenses, both temples visible in three-quarter product view.; Black smooth leather belt with simple silver rectangular buckle, complete belt shown in a loose oval.; A worn olive green canvas messenger bag with tan brown leather panels, patches and broad adjustable strap.; One classic silver metal bracelet wristwatch with simple light dial, shown alone.. Use each accessory once. Neckties are tied with one knot and the narrow tail hidden; for sweater layers tuck the long tail under the sweater. No additional accessories or props.
original_prompt: Create ONE complete photorealistic hollow wardrobe outfit on a pure white background, portrait 2:3, soft studio light. FIRST reference is the exact clothing base; preserve its cuts, colors, layers and footwear. Other references are individual accessory products belonging to this look. Garments: White fitted short sleeve tee, light washed blue wide-leg jeans, dark shoes conservatively completed below cropped reference.. Add EXACTLY these accessories and no others: Black narrow rectangular sunglasses with dark lenses, both temples visible in three-quarter product view.; Black smooth leather belt with simple silver rectangular buckle, complete belt shown in a loose oval.; A worn olive green canvas messenger bag with tan brown leather panels, patches and broad adjustable strap.; One classic silver metal bracelet wristwatch with simple light dial, shown alone.. Arrange as a single cohesive empty outfit: tie at collar, belt at waist, scarf draped naturally, hat/eyewear hovering above empty neck if present, necklace around empty collar; bag beside hip with full strap. Watches, gloves or small jewelry can be placed neatly beside outfit, each once. No visible person, body, face, skin, hands, legs, mannequin, stand or hanger. Empty neck and sleeves. Preserve fully visible garments, shoes, accessory shapes, full chains and straps within frame. No source photos, collages, labels, text, props or watermark.
